data.name: Aravian
data.short_meaning: Name of a place in the Bible
data.long_meaning: The name Aravian is mentioned in the Bible as the name of a place located in the land of Canaan (Joshua 15:16). It is believed to be derived from the Hebrew word 'Aravah' which means 'desert' or 'wasteland'. However, some sources suggest that it may also be derived from the Greek word 'Aravos' meaning 'mountainous land'. In any case, the name has a rich biblical heritage and is a beautiful choice for a Christian girl.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aravian is a name that carries a sense of the wilderness and the rugged beauty of the natural world. It reminds us of the power and majesty of God in creation and the promise of new beginnings and growth in barren places.
